definitions.explanation: The upcoming period, version, or successor in a sequence, especially for positions, products, or plans.

examples.japanese: {次期|じき}{社長|しゃちょう}は{誰|だれ}だろう。
examples.english: I wonder who the next president will be.

examples.japanese: {次期|じき}モデルが{発表|はっぴょう}された。
{次期|じき}{大統領|だいとうりょう}{候補|こうほ}として{名前|なまえ}が{挙|あ}がっている。
examples.english: His name is being mentioned as a candidate for the next president.

notes:
Functions as a prefix-like modifier placed before nouns to indicate the next one in a sequence. Very common in news and business contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {次期|じき}{社長|しゃちょう} — the next company president
- {次期|じき}{大統領|だいとうりょう} — the next president
- {次期|じき}モデル — the next model/version
- {次期|じき}{計画|けいかく} — the next plan
- {次期|じき}{候補|こうほ} — next-in-line candidate

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {時期|じき} — time period, season (same pronunciation, different meaning)
- {次|つぎ}の — next (everyday, general purpose)
- {来期|らいき} — next term/period (specifically about fiscal or academic terms)

USAGE:
{次期|じき} implies a formal succession or planned replacement. Use {次|つぎ}の for everyday "next" and {次期|じき} when discussing successors to positions, product lines, or official plans.
